patch_description: Key changes over the current program: (1) Beam restarts are now seeded with a heuristic-plus-random mix — the top-2 transactions by single-transaction cost plus one random pick — instead of {0, rand, rand}. This injects the deterministic lookahead strength early in construction, which the prior recommendation identified as high-value. (2) Beam width and restart count are raised (more of the 40% construction budget spent productively). (3) Randomized greedy uses full lookahead (sample_rate=1) more often, matching the strong full-lookahead greedy. (4) ILS keeps more top candidates (6), uses first-improvement insertion/swap (accept immediately, faster descent), and deduplicates by cost+tuple. (5) Slightly larger time budget utilization with tighter deadline checks. These parameter changes reduce wasted evaluations on bad seeds and concentrate search on the most promising basins, lowering makespan.
